articles.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: BNB Chain pursues legal action after ex-employee’s memecoin launch
articles.summary: BNB Chain said a former employee allegedly used a company tutorial wallet to create a memecoin that the company says it did not authorize or endorse.

articles.title: Trump Media sells another 2,628 BTC, holdings fall to 4,261 BTC
articles.summary: Trump Media transferred another 2,628 Bitcoin to Crypto.com, bringing its reported sales over seven months to 7,281 BTC and leaving the company with 4,261 BTC in holdings.

articles.title: Coldcard hack sparks biggest sub-1 BTC move since FTX: CryptoQuant
articles.summary: Bitcoin users moved 39,600 BTC in small transactions as the Coldcard hack continued, with researchers warning that the attack remained active.

articles.title: Onchain, in court: What happened in crypto legal news this week
articles.summary: A case tied to defunct crypto exchange FTX moves forward, a soldier seeks to dismiss over a Polymarket bet and a former congressman was ordered to pay $35,000 for manipulative trading.

articles.title: Minnesota crypto ATM ban goes into effect after reported $1M losses
articles.summary: State officials reported that Minnesota residents, and largely senior citizens, had lost about $1 million from scams tied to crypto kiosks from 2023 to 2025.

articles.title: Crypto PAC pours another $1M into Michigan House race
articles.summary: Michigan incumbent Shri Thanedar’s re-election bid against other Democratic candidates is getting more about crypto with an infusion of ads funded by an industry-aligned PAC.

articles.title: Russia expands crypto mining ban to Moscow through 2032
articles.summary: Russia has added Moscow, the Moscow Region and parts of Kursk Region to its cryptocurrency mining ban list, citing power supply concerns behind the restrictions.

articles.title: Coldcard Bitcoin loss estimate rises to $70M after Galaxy analysis
articles.summary: Galaxy Research identified 1,196 addresses that lost 1,082.65 Bitcoin in a 41-minute window, expanding the estimated scope of the Coldcard wallet incident.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs end July in the green despite late-month selling
articles.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs attracted $172.4 million in July inflows but remained $5.3 billion negative year to date after heavy withdrawals in May and June.

articles.title: Bank of Italy finds no consistent cost advantage for stablecoin remittances
articles.summary: Researchers found that fiat conversion costs and payment infrastructure, rather than blockchain fees, accounted for most of the differences in stablecoin remittance costs and settlement times.

articles.title: Pump.fun laid off workers before they received millions in PUMP tokens: Report
articles.summary: Pump.fun co-founder Noah Tweedale reportedly attributed the layoffs to the company growing too quickly.

articles.title: Ex-FTX users report funds being released in $900M distribution round
articles.summary: Several users of the long-defunct crypto exchange reported that distribution agents had begun releasing funds to reimburse creditors for some of their 2022 losses.

articles.title: Tether earns $1.5B in Q2 as US Treasury holdings fuel profits
articles.summary: Tether’s reserve surplus grew to $4.11 billion in the second quarter as USDT supply rose despite a weaker stablecoin market and continued pressure across the crypto sector.

articles.title: Bybit adds tokenized Nvidia, Apple, Tesla stocks as loan collateral
articles.summary: Eligible retail and institutional users can use tokenized shares of Nvidia, Apple, Tesla and three other US companies across Bybit’s trading and lending products.

articles.title: US Treasury yields rise as TIPS challenge the inflation narrative
articles.summary: TIPS data points to rising real yields, not inflation, a dynamic that weighs on non-yielding assets like Bitcoin.

articles.title: Bitcoin price sinks to 2-week lows as US stocks fail to copy Asia rebound
articles.summary: Bitcoin saw fresh downside pressure as US stocks tracked sideways into the end of the month, diverging from the relief bounce seen in Asia.

articles.title: ECB says digital euro app will exceed EU accessibility standards
articles.summary: The European Central Bank proposed accessibility standards for its planned digital euro app, saying it would be one of several ways users could access basic digital euro services.

articles.title: AMLBot launches AI Tracer for self-service blockchain investigations
articles.summary: Crypto forensics company AMLBot launched an AI-enabled tool allowing users with no specialist knowledge to trace their digital assets, even after they are stolen.

articles.title: Circle receives New York trust charter for subsidiary
articles.summary: The New York trust charter allows Circle’s subsidiary to provide fiduciary and custody services under state banking law.

articles.title: BOJ intervenes to defend yen near 160, holds rates steady
articles.summary: The Japanese yen crosses a key psychological level after the country’s central bank reportedly conducted a major currency intervention.

articles.title: Citadel buys bulk of Situational Awareness stock portfolio after AI rout: Reports
articles.summary: Situational Awareness retained about $10 billion in assets, including its Anthropic stake, after reportedly selling leveraged public stock positions to Ken Griffin’s Citadel.

articles.title: BIS Project Agorá settles $1 million in tokenized cross-border payment trials
articles.summary: Twenty-eight financial institutions and central banks completed real-value settlements across six currencies using tokenized central bank reserves and commercial bank deposits.

articles.title: New York sues Kalshi over alleged illegal gambling operation
articles.summary: The lawsuit adds to a growing clash between New York and the CFTC over whether federally regulated prediction markets are subject to state gambling laws.

articles.title: Aave weighs closing 6 V3 blockchain markets, offboarding 50 low-use reserves
articles.summary: DeFi risk management service LlamaRisk recommended that Aave wind down every reserve on Sonic, Scroll, zkSync, Metis, Soneium and Aptos, but action against most of those instances was already taken.

articles.title: RWA perpetual futures volume nears Bitcoin on Hyperliquid, Binance
articles.summary: RWA perpetual futures reached 99.2% of Bitcoin perpetual volume on Hyperliquid and Binance as tokenized equities led trading.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs post $233M inflows, pushing week back into the green
articles.summary: BlackRock’s IBIT led $233.1 million in daily inflows as US spot Bitcoin ETFs turned positive for the week and July stayed on track to end in the green.

articles.title: Crypto’s next altseason may have fewer winners: Wintermute
articles.summary: Institutional investors accounted for 72% of Wintermute’s spot OTC flow in the first half of 2026 as capital clustered in fewer tokens and altcoin rallies became more selective.

articles.title: Coldcard issues Mk3 warning as experts examine $38M Bitcoin wallet drain
articles.summary: Coinkite urged Coldcard Mk3 users to migrate funds after identifying a potential seed-generation risk, as Bitcoin security experts separately examine an unexplained $38 million wallet drain.

articles.title: Bhutan’s Gelephu taps 3iQ to manage part of Bitcoin treasury
articles.summary: 3iQ will manage an undisclosed portion of Gelephu Mindfulness City’s Bitcoin treasury as Bhutan develops a digital-asset investment hub.
